record_title: Sharp two-mode transient amplification for CG_AOS after exact initialization
provenance: Scientific record documenting an exact quadratic theorem, its proof, a symbolic verification artifact, and literature context.
limitations: Exact-arithmetic result for the first CG_AOS step after exact initialization on a two-eigenmode invariant subspace. It establishes sharp transient amplification and a two-mode damping threshold, not asymptotic divergence or a global convergence theorem. The full text of Ni and Liu (2024), DOI 10.1080/01630563.2024.2333255, was not inspected and remains the main residual originality risk.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Symbolically verifies the explicit diagonal family and objective-ratio identities.
Verified symbolic output for the explicit family using Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0.
